preview: Dashboards that build themselves, alerts that know when to stay quiet, and three numbers from November.

hero.title: Dashboards that build themselves
hero.intro: This month Kestrel learned to read your events and lay out the board you would have built by hand. Below: what shipped, what it changed for teams already using it, and what lands next.

features.title: Auto-boards
features.body: Point Kestrel at a stream and it drafts a dashboard: the right chart per metric, sensible ranges, and a summary line on top. Keep it, tweak it, or throw it away.

features.title: Quiet alerts
features.body: Alerts now learn your weekly rhythm. A dip every Sunday night is not an incident, so Kestrel stops paging you for it.

features.title: Shared lenses
features.body: Save a filtered view as a lens and share it with one link. Finance and product finally look at the same number.

quote.text: We deleted forty hand-made dashboards in a week. Nobody noticed, except that the new ones were right.
quote.author: Priya Raman
